title: 2.5-Billion-Year-Old 'Time Capsule' Discovered: Earth's Second-Oldest Orbicular Rock Found In MP
description: Published by researchers from prominent institutions, including Banaras Hindu University, IIT Kanpur, IISER Berhampur, Brazil's University of Campinas, and Japan’s JAIST, the study offers a rare glimpse into the chaotic magmatic processes of the Neoarchean era.
